criteria.detail: Reading one, centre against zero in units of the series' own far-deviation cut: type A (B9 main arm) 0.080; type C cells B21, whole window 2.921; B5 pairs with the official rate, before 2025-04-14 2.352; B97 Cyprus, edge cut 3.857. Every type C cell above the type A cell: True. Reading two on B9 main arm, daily: above, on the Gaussian ladder {'at_or_faster_than': 1} in steps of one trading day. No criterion is hung on a rival here. A scalar price field says every loop sum is zero at all times, so it has no object for what a loop sum does after it has moved away, and this framework makes no opposite point prediction in that cell.
